title: Terminal Unresponsive / Frozen
symptom: Touchscreen does not respond to input, display is stuck on a single screen.
possibleCause: NewPOS software memory leak or background process hang.
resolution: Perform a hard reboot. Hold the power button on the bottom right of the screen for 10 seconds until it powers off, then press once to turn back on.

title: Cash Drawer Not Opening
symptom: Drawer does not kick open after cash transaction.
possibleCause: RJ11 cable disconnected from the receipt printer, or receipt printer out of paper.
resolution: Check the cable connecting the drawer to the printer. Ensure printer has paper and is powered on, as the kick signal routes through the printer.

title: Network Error on Login
symptom: Crew receives 'Unable to reach Store Server' when swiping ID card.
possibleCause: Ethernet cable unplugged or switch port issue.
resolution: Verify the network cable under the counter is securely plugged in. Check for link lights on the RJ45 port.
escalation: Check the network switch in the back office.

title: Blank Screen
symptom: Monitor is black, but power LED is amber.
possibleCause: No video signal from KVS controller.
resolution: Check the HDMI/DisplayPort cable between the monitor and the KVS node. Reboot the KVS node.

title: Orders Not Appearing
symptom: POS is ringing items, but they don't show on the KVS.
possibleCause: KVS node lost network connection to the store server.
resolution: Restart the KVS application remotely via VNC. If unreachable, manually power cycle the KVS node.

title: Display Flickering
symptom: Screen image drops out randomly or flickers.
possibleCause: Heat damage to the video cable or monitor board.
resolution: Reseat the video cable. Move cables away from direct heat sources (fryer/grill vats).

title: Touchscreen Inaccurate
symptom: Tapping an order selects the one next to it.
possibleCause: Screen calibration is off, likely due to grease buildup.
resolution: Clean the screen thoroughly with approved electronics wipe. Run the Elo Touch calibration utility.

title: Receipts Not Printing
symptom: Expeditor taps 'Serve' but no grill slip prints.
possibleCause: Printer paper jam or USB connection lost.
resolution: Clear paper jam. Verify USB cable between KVS node and printer.

title: Display Blank in Drive-Thru
symptom: Outdoor screen is off, customers cannot see orders.
possibleCause: Power trip or tripped GFI breaker on outdoor circuit.
resolution: Ask manager to check the store's breaker panel for the Drive-Thru circuit.

title: No Signal Message
symptom: Screen shows 'No Signal' bouncing around.
possibleCause: Fiber optic media converter failure inside the COD enclosure.
resolution: Power cycle the COD unit from inside the store.
escalation: Field visit required to replace media converter.

title: Order Data Lag
symptom: Items appear on screen 5-10 seconds after cashier rings them.
possibleCause: Network congestion or poor fiber termination.
resolution: Restart the DT controller service on the back-office server.

title: Static on Channel A
symptom: Crew hears loud static when listening to customers.
possibleCause: Speaker post microphone interference or physical damage to post.
resolution: Check the speaker post for water ingress or loose wires.
escalation: Replace microphone element in the outdoor post.

title: Headset Won't Turn On
symptom: Inserting a fresh battery does nothing, no LED.
possibleCause: Corroded battery contacts inside the headset.
resolution: Clean contacts with a dry swab.

title: Echo During Ordering
symptom: Customer hears their own voice echoing back.
possibleCause: Acoustic echo cancellation failed on base station.
resolution: Restart the HME base station in the manager's office.

title: Cross-talk from Lane 2
symptom: Lane 1 cashier hears Lane 2 customer.
possibleCause: Headset paired to the wrong lane.
resolution: Re-pair the headset to the correct lane by docking it in the base station programming port.

title: Store Offline
symptom: Credit cards failing, app orders not dropping in.
possibleCause: Primary fiber line cut or ISP outage.
resolution: Verify if the 4G LTE backup has activated. If not, power cycle the Delphi router.
escalation: Contact TM (Telekom Malaysia) for line check.

title: High Latency
symptom: POS operations are slow, especially card payments.
possibleCause: Running on 4G backup with poor signal.
resolution: Check Delphi router dashboard to see active WAN. If on backup, troubleshoot primary line.

title: Multiple Devices Down
symptom: All POS or all KVS offline simultaneously.
possibleCause: Switch lockup or tripped breaker.
resolution: Check switch status lights. Power cycle if frozen.

title: PoE Failure
symptom: Cameras and APs are offline, but PCs work.
possibleCause: Switch PoE budget exceeded or PoE power supply failure.
resolution: Check Meraki dashboard for PoE alerts.

title: Tablets Not Connecting
symptom: Manager tablets cannot connect to internal Wi-Fi.
possibleCause: AP offline or firmware update stuck.
resolution: Check switch port connecting the AP. Bounce the PoE port to restart the AP.

title: Weak Signal in Kitchen
symptom: Devices constantly dropping connection near the grill.
possibleCause: Interference from stainless steel equipment or microwave ovens.
resolution: Analyze channel utilization. If needed, relocate AP to a better line of sight.

title: Keys Not Registering
symptom: Pressing buttons on the bump bar does nothing.
possibleCause: USB disconnected or physical damage to the membrane.
resolution: Reseat the USB cable. Try a different USB port on the KVS node.
escalation: Replace the bump bar if membrane is pierced or worn out.

title: Double Typing
symptom: Pressing 'Bump' once clears two orders.
possibleCause: Sticky key due to grease intrusion.
resolution: Clean the bump bar with warm soapy water (it is sealed). Do not use harsh chemicals.

title: Card Reader Error
symptom: Kiosk displays 'Payment Device Offline'.
possibleCause: Ingenico terminal lost USB sync with kiosk PC.
resolution: Hold the yellow 'Clear' and '.' buttons on the PIN pad to reboot it.

title: Receipt Printer Out of Paper
symptom: Kiosk stops accepting orders, light flashes red.
possibleCause: Paper roll empty or jammed.
resolution: Instruct crew to open the kiosk door, replace the paper roll, and clear any jams.

title: Touchscreen Unresponsive
symptom: Screen displays normally but ignores touch.
possibleCause: USB cable to touch controller loose, or OS driver issue.
resolution: Reboot the kiosk PC via the power button inside the cabinet.

title: Application Crash
symptom: Kiosk showing Windows desktop instead of order screen.
possibleCause: Kiosk application crashed due to unhandled exception or update failure.
resolution: Double-tap the 'Kiosk Launcher' shortcut on the desktop.
